name: NovoPsych
short_description: Library of 150+ validated psychological assessments with instant scoring, graphs over time, and an optional AI note tool.
long_description: NovoPsych sends validated measures (PHQ-9, GAD-7, DASS-21 and 150+ others) to clients by email, SMS or QR code, scores them instantly with percentile comparisons, and graphs change over time. It also includes NovoNote, an AI scribe. A free plan covers up to 5 assessments and 15 clients a month; Pro plans are priced by 'Pro Actions' (a completed assessment or an AI-generated note), from AUD $30/month for 50. Practice plans start from $20 per practitioner per month. The company is Australian and stores data in Australia unless otherwise agreed.
one_liner: Validated assessments sent, scored and graphed for you, with a free tier.
best_for: Psychologists who need a broad range of assessment and diagnostic scales
Solo clinicians starting measurement-based care on a free plan (5 assessments a month)
Clinicians who want PHQ-9 and GAD-7 sent by SMS or email and scored automatically
Australian and UK practices, where the platform originates
not_for: US practices that require patient data stored in the United States
Practices that need scores flowing into their EHR automatically
High-volume clinicians on lower tiers, where assessments count against the monthly Pro Action cap
